summary: Sandbach United secured a hard-fought 1-0 victory at Brereton Social, with Robbie Hatton scoring a dramatic added-time volley at the far post to snatch all three points. It was a scrappy affair with few chances created and both defences firmly on top, but the away side showed resilience and character to come away with the win. The Bach's supporters were praised for their excellent travelling support on what proved to be a day where grit trumped style.
